mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 317.685 in the next month signals rising inflation expectations, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 317.685 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL crossing the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a positive feedback loop, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS do not both rise in the 60-day horizon, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, elevated demand (GDPC1) and suppressed supply (INDPRO) signal overexpansion, leading to investor caution and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or returns are negative outside the regime.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust job creation, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not correlate with positive 5-day returns (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 above 23400.294 in the next 3 months signals robust economic activity, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 23400.294 in the next 3 months
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross the threshold in the next 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Both demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) rising simultaneously creates a virtuous cycle of economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST do not both rise in the 60-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight monetary policy regime characterized by high FEDFUNDS and elevated UNRATE, investors anticipate prolonged high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In tight monetary policy regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05), or returns are negative outside the regime.
